presentation.title: SZL Holographic Unify
presentation.summary: An estate command interface connecting the SZL Forge and Serve surfaces. This Space runs a small CPU web runtime and exposes source and honesty information.
presentation.stage: CPU interface; GPU features remain roadmap
visible_limits: GPU vLLM serving and Unsloth training remain ROADMAP in this Space.
Energy joules are UNAVAILABLE without an actual measurement; this surface does not supply NVML measurements.
Lambda uniqueness remains Conjecture 1. Runtime readiness does not establish model quality or execution authority.

Runtime readiness is not model-quality or execution-authority evidence. No publisher invocation or provider change is performed by this source-only preparation.
